- Place the smaller paddle and ping-pong ball in the lower left of center; place the smaller shuttlecock diagonally in the lower middle with visible air around its feather silhouette. Keep the dark-blue unnumbered billiard ball as a small quiet accent near the right of the central group.

The objects can float very gently above the studio surface with natural soft shadows, no exaggerated airborne explosion. Do NOT spread objects all the way to the image edges: keep total object grouping approximately within the middle 60% of the panorama, with generous clear light-blue margins left and right and breathing room top and bottom. Keep all objects fully within canvas. Preserve the character of the chosen image.
Do not add or remove any object. No red/blue abstract props. Absolutely no text, words, letters, numerals, score displays, logos, watermark, device frames, gambling chips or money. Suit pips and mahjong pictograms permitted. Opaque image.
